name: INTERCEPTOR | TRAFKA STUDIO
description: This event features INTERCEPTOR and TRAFKA STUDIO, focusing on electronic music. It is scheduled for November 13, 2026, at Ferro Bar in Porto.
longDescription:
INTERCEPTOR and TRAFKA STUDIO will perform at Ferro Bar in Porto. The event is categorized under Music & Festivals, specifically electronic music.

The performance is set for Friday, November 13, 2026, starting at 22:00. The duration is approximately 5 hours, with no interval planned. The promoter for this event is Pensamentos Vadios, Lda.

Tickets are priced at 7€ for general admission. The venue, Ferro Bar, is located at Rua Da Madeira, 84, 4000-427 Porto. The event has an age rating of 16+.
